Policies and Initiatives.title: Believe it or not: This AI minister is expecting... 83 AI kids
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Albania's AI Minister, Diella, is expecting 83 digital AI assistants to aid Socialist Party MPs. These AI tools will record parliamentary proceedings, update officials, and suggest debate strategies to enhance governance and combat corruption. The initiative is expected to be fully functional by late 2026.

Major AI Developments.title: Google Gemini launches JEE Main mock test papers: IIT Kharagpur alumnus Sundar Pichai goes nostalgic, ‘If I could…’
Major AI Developments.summary: Google Gemini has launched free mock JEE Main test papers that simulate real exam conditions, offering instant performance analysis and personalized study plans. The launch was celebrated by Sundar Pichai, an IIT Kharagpur alumnus, who expressed nostalgia and appreciation for the initiative. The AI platform aims to support students preparing for the JEE Main exam with its innovative features.
